info.name: MedConnect – manual test
info.description: Manual end-to-end walkthrough of MedConnect through the API Gateway. Run the folders in order on a fresh stack; see docs/manual-testing-guide.md. Disable SSL certificate verification (self-signed dev certificate).

item.name: 01 Identity (S-F1-01, S-F1-02, refresh, D10)
item.description: Registration, login, refresh rotation, staff logins.

item.name: Register patient A again -> 409 email taken
Refresh again with the used token -> 401 (single use)
03 Shifts and availability (scheduling)
item.description: doctor1 gets a shift and goes FREE; doctor2 has no shift and no scope.

item.name: doctor1 GET doctors availability -> doctor1 FREE (resend until it matches)
doctor1 GET queue stats -> HIGH 0 / MEDIUM 0 / LOW 0 (resend until it matches)

request.description: Counts assume a fresh stack and that this collection is the only client.

exec: pm.test("HIGH 0, MEDIUM 0, LOW 0", () => pm.expect([q.HIGH.waiting, q.MEDIUM.waiting, q.LOW.waiting]).to.eql([0, 0, 0]));

item.name: 04 Intake and triage rule set v1 (F3)
item.description: Four patients, one per rule. Wait ~1-2 s after each POST before checking status (triage is asynchronous).

item.name: A replay same Idempotency-Key -> 202 same consultation
A POST again with a new key -> 409 active consultation (S-F3-05)
Patient A GET consultation -> WAITING / HIGH (resend until it matches)
A GET own triage -> 200 without ruleId
doctor1 GET triage A -> HIGH R2_CRITICAL_SYMPTOM (resend until it matches)
doctor1 GET triage B -> LOW R4_DEFAULT (resend until it matches)
doctor1 GET triage C -> MEDIUM R3_FEVER_HIGH_PAIN (resend until it matches)
doctor1 GET triage D -> HIGH R1_RED_FLAG (resend until it matches)
doctor1 GET queue stats -> HIGH 2 / MEDIUM 1 / LOW 1 (resend until it matches)

request.description: Counts assume a fresh stack and that this collection is the only client.

exec: pm.test("HIGH 2, MEDIUM 1, LOW 1", () => pm.expect([q.HIGH.waiting, q.MEDIUM.waiting, q.LOW.waiting]).to.eql([2, 1, 1]));

item.name: 05 Re-triage, override, cancel (S-F3-07/08, S-F4-10)
item.description: B moves LOW -> HIGH by symptoms, back to LOW by override, then cancels.

item.name: doctor1 GET triage B -> HIGH, triageVersion 2 (resend until it matches)
doctor1 GET queue stats -> HIGH 3 / MEDIUM 1 / LOW 0 (resend until it matches)

request.description: Counts assume a fresh stack and that this collection is the only client.

exec: pm.test("HIGH 3, MEDIUM 1, LOW 0", () => pm.expect([q.HIGH.waiting, q.MEDIUM.waiting, q.LOW.waiting]).to.eql([3, 1, 0]));

item.name: doctor1 override B reason too short -> 422
doctor1 override B to same priority -> 409
doctor1 GET queue stats -> HIGH 2 / MEDIUM 1 / LOW 1 (resend until it matches)

request.description: Counts assume a fresh stack and that this collection is the only client.

exec: pm.test("HIGH 2, MEDIUM 1, LOW 1", () => pm.expect([q.HIGH.waiting, q.MEDIUM.waiting, q.LOW.waiting]).to.eql([2, 1, 1]));

item.name: doctor1 GET queue stats -> HIGH 2 / MEDIUM 1 / LOW 0 (resend until it matches)

request.description: Counts assume a fresh stack and that this collection is the only client.

exec: pm.test("HIGH 2, MEDIUM 1, LOW 0", () => pm.expect([q.HIGH.waiting, q.MEDIUM.waiting, q.LOW.waiting]).to.eql([2, 1, 0]));

item.name: 06 Claim, video, prescription, complete (F4, F5)
item.description: doctor1 claims the oldest HIGH patient (A) and runs the whole consultation.

item.name: doctor1 replay same claim key -> 201 same assignment
doctor1 claim with new key while BUSY -> 409 (S-F4-06)
doctor1 GET doctors availability -> doctor1 BUSY (resend until it matches)
Patient A GET consultation -> ASSIGNED (resend until it matches)

request.description: A 409 right after start means prescription-service has not consumed ConsultationStarted yet: resend.

item.name: doctor1 GET doctors availability -> doctor1 FREE (resend until it matches)
07 Recording (F2)
item.description: Recording becomes AVAILABLE up to ~60 s after completion.

item.name: doctor1 GET recording A -> AVAILABLE (resend until)
08 Audit trail
item.description: Every event is stored append-only; doctor1 has audit:read.

item.name: doctor1 audit for A -> full lifecycle
doctor1 audit for B -> override with actor (S-F3-07)
09 No-show (S-F4-09) – waits 5 min
item.description: doctor1 claims D; D never joins. After ~5 min 15 s the consultation is NO_SHOW and doctor1 is FREE again.

item.name: Patient D GET consultation -> ASSIGNED (resend until it matches)
Patient D GET consultation -> NO_SHOW (resend until it matches)
doctor1 GET doctors availability -> doctor1 FREE (resend until it matches)
10 MEDIUM patient, then empty queues (S-F4-02, S-F4-05)
item.description: HIGH is empty now, so doctor1 gets C (MEDIUM).

item.name: Patient C GET consultation -> ASSIGNED (resend until it matches)
doctor1 GET doctors availability -> doctor1 FREE (resend until it matches)
doctor1 claim with empty queues -> 204 (S-F4-05) (resend until it matches)
11 Account lockout (D10)
item.description: Send "wrong password" 4 times (401); the 5th failure locks the account (423), and even the correct password returns 423 for 15 min.
